ra.title: NVIDIA SuperPOD DGX B300 Systems, Spectrum-4 Ethernet and DC Busbar Power Reference Architecture

system.name: DGX B300
system.psus: DC busbar 54 VDC (no per-system PSUs); rack uses DGX power shelves: four 1U 33 kW shelves per 4-system rack (RA: six 5.5 kW shelf modules, N redundancy, 33 kW each)

compute_nics.type: NVIDIA ConnectX-8 (8 x OSFP, 800 Gb/s IB/Ethernet; 2 OSFP cages x 4 ports on rear tray)

system.storage_inband_nics: 2 x dual-port NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU (B3240), 400 Gb/s; each DPU has 1 in-band mgmt QSFP + 1 storage QSFP (=2 storage + 2 in-band ports/system)
system.bmc: BMC 1 GbE RJ-45 (Redfish/IPMI/KVM); plus host LAN 1GbE RJ-45 and BMC ports on each BlueField (XDR RA: both BF3 BMCs to OOB)

su.note_on_ufm_displacement: Not stated. UFM 3.5 appliances (x2) manage only the IB storage fabric and sit in the management rack; no statement that UFM displaces DGX systems in the SU.
su.mgmt_racks: Fig.4 shows 12 rows-1/2 infrastructure racks (per SU pair of rows): per Fig 3/4 mgmt/network racks include Inband spine+leaf + 3 OOB leaf, compute spine, 4x compute leaf, 2 DGX storage leaf, 2 storage spine, 7 Mission Control nodes rack, 8 storage appliances + 2 storage UFM; DC guide: 8 network/mgmt/storage racks per 64-node SU, 16 DGX racks. Table 7 (4 SU): 72 busbar MGX racks + 8 MGX racks without busbar

compute_fabric.tech: NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet (800G CX-8 split as 2x400GbE to two planes), rail-optimized, twin-plane full fat-tree, 2-layer leaf-spine (no core)

storage_fabric.tech: InfiniBand NDR 400G (QM9700/QM9701) or Ethernet RoCE (SN5600/SN5600D) - two options; per-node I/O must exceed 40 GBps
storage_fabric.counts: 4-SU/256-node Table 7: Eth storage: 8 DGX-side leaf + 2 storage-side leaf + 4 spine SN5600(DC); IB storage: 16 DGX-side leaf + 4 storage-side leaf + 8 spine NDR
storage_fabric.ratio: Storage devices 1:1 port:uplink; DGX connections oversubscribed near 4:3

inband.tech: Ethernet, VXLAN/EVPN segmented shared physical network with OOB
inband.speed: 400G BF3 ports in Table 7 (RA text: 200 Gbps bonded for resiliency)

oob.switch_model: NVIDIA SN2201 (SN2201M variant noted in Table 1)
oob.counts: 4-SU Table 7: 33 + 33 SN2201 (two P/Ns, 920-9N110-00R1-0C0 and -NC0 = 66 total); 66 x 100G DR1 transceivers

mgmt_plane.ufm: 2 x UFM 3.5 Appliance Enterprise (storage IB fabric only); NVIDIA NetQ for Spectrum-X compute fabric telemetry
mgmt_plane.bcm_or_mgmt_nodes: NVIDIA Mission Control (includes BCM + Run:ai): BCM HA 2 nodes (Inband+OOB), K8s mgmt 3 nodes (Inband+storage), Slurm login 2 nodes (Inband+storage) = 7 control-plane nodes; all on OOB 1GbE
mgmt_plane.other: Customer edge: >=2x100GbE DR1 single-mode, BGP; user storage NFS >=100G DR1 on SN5600D leaf; Table 7 home storage AFF A90A (example)

ambiguities: This is one of TWO B300 SuperPOD RAs: this file = Spectrum-X/DC busbar (64 nodes/SU, RA-11337-001); b300-xdr.json = Quantum-X800 XDR IB/AC (72 nodes/SU, RA-11339-001). NVIDIA site says each is 'DGX B300'.

Table 3 (SU count table) lists 2048 node-leaf / 2048 leaf-spine cables for 4 SU, but Table 7 lists 4096 DGX-Leaf and 4096 Leaf-Spine cables and 2048 DGX-side transceivers; likely 2048 NIC ports (800G twin-port) x 2 planes = 4096 400G links. Unresolved.

Table 3 caption text says scale 'up to and beyond 64 SU with 2000+ nodes' but table stops at 16 SU; text also says 'reference architecture is focused on 4 SU / 256 nodes' while fig 6 shows 8 SU / 512-node.
GPU memory: RA says '2.1 TB aggregated HBM3e'; user guide says 8x288GB = 2.3 TB (2304 GB used here).

Inband/storage NIC speed: RA text says in-band 200 Gbps bonded; Table 7 and user guide indicate 400G BF3 ports (512 x 400G transceivers for BF3240 per 256 nodes = 2 per node each for storage and inband).

Storage 'fabric is IB OR Ethernet'; the RA gives both option counts in Table 7 simultaneously (Eth storage and IB storage), so totals are not additive. Text says 'slightly oversubscribed 4:3' but does not give port counts.
Text says storage per-node bandwidth 'at least 40 Gbps' (components page) vs 'exceed 40 GBps' (network fabrics). Likely GBps.
Compute switch port count and Spectrum-4 SN5600 radix not stated in RA text (SN5600 = 64x800G/128x400G by datasheet knowledge, not from RA). Leaves per SU 16 derived from Table 3.

Rack counts: Fig.3 shows 16 DGX racks (2 rows x 8) per SU; DC guide lists 16 DGX racks + 8 network/mgmt/storage racks per 64-node SU. Table 7 4-SU has 72+8 racks (=64 DGX racks + 16 infrastructure), consistent.
DC guide rack weight table appears swapped: DC busbar '1122kg (2474 lbs)' vs AC '1301 kg (1170 lbs)' (1170 lb != 1301 kg). Not used.
Cooling field: system is air-cooled; DC guide recommends active RDHx at rack level for the 4/rack busbar pattern (hybrid at rack level). Set 'air'.
max_power_kw 14.5 is user guide 'Power consumption'; peak 19 kW (busbar)/19.7 kW (AC) is an estimate from DC guide. UG 'Power inlets 12 (AC only)'.
UFM displacement: no text about UFM taking leaf ports in the Spectrum-X RA (UFM serves IB storage only).
'OOB' SN2201 counts: Table 7 lists 33+33 = 66 switches for 4 SU with 15/38 RJ45 cable counts garbled ('15 / 38 Total RJ45 Count').
